lead.headline: OpenAI ships GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol: more work for fewer tokens, and Astra gets 20% cheaper
lead.summary: Astra is the new frontier model for hard projects, Sol the everyday default, and both are live in ChatGPT Work and Codex and in the API. OpenAI says Astra beats Claude Fable 5.2 by 5.5 points on Agents' Last Exam at 5% of the cost, and writes cleaner code and better frontends. Astra API pricing drops to $8 in / $40 out per million tokens (cached input $0.40); Sol stays at $2 / $10. Artificial Analysis still ranks Astra second, just behind Fable 5.2.

number_of_day.label: What Tampere and the other eVaka municipalities paid for the AI-assisted mobile upgrade (notifications and biometric sign-in). A separate native app was estimated in 2024 at €400,000, plus about €400,000 a year to maintain.

news.headline: Microsoft drops seven cheap MAI models at Ignite, led by MAI Code 2
news.summary: Microsoft says MAI Code 2 reaches 98% of GPT-6.1 Sol's coding quality at about 40% of the price, and 96% of Opus 5.5 at 5% of the price. The lineup also has Code 2 Flash, Cyber 2 Flash, Image 2.7 and Realtime 1 (from $0.01 per audio minute), and its Maia 200 chip is now in production. MAI Code 2 and Code 2 Flash are already in GitHub Copilot.

news.headline: Replit Missions: give a swarm of agents an outcome and a budget
news.summary: You set the goal and the limits, and Replit coordinates parallel agents that plan, build, test and iterate. Replit's own demo: in two days and within a $3,000 budget, a swarm built DataCat, an in-house monitoring platform with dashboards, alerts and tracing, tested against performance and reliability goals.

news.headline: eVaka now works like a phone app, built with Claude instead of a €400k native app
news.summary: A Reaktor developer prototyped the progressive web app with Claude in a couple of days, and the team then refined it almost weekly for five months, shifting effort from coding to user journeys and design. You can add eVaka to your home screen, get notifications and sign in with fingerprint or face. The city now plans to revisit requests once deemed too costly.

news.headline: Ex-Swappie CEO's AI healthtech Treat raises a €3M pre-seed in Helsinki
news.summary: byFounders and Illusian led the round. Sami Marttinen started Treat after his wife went through nine private doctor visits before a diagnosis: it has doctors review a patient's history before connecting them in minutes. Co-founders are doctor Antti Mauno and engineer Onni Wahlberg; Marttinen says the deal closed in a week.

writers_corner.title: The horse made the state
writers_corner.take: A Mongolian historian argues states grew out of transport and conquest, horses, boats and herders, not grain stores, and that the farming-first story wrote pastoralists out of history.
writers_corner.quote: Transportation – not grain – is what brought the state and civilisation into existence, and what continues to maintain them.
